items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: That's where Bert Williams and all the big acts played years ago.

ctx.x: Pekin? Pekin was down further on 20 -- 31st -- around about 27th Street. That was an old vaudeville house. That's where Bert Williams and all the big acts played years ago.
Well, I mean did they have bands in there?
